aggregation: Disjoint area reports from four Sprites at one revision and suite hash. No cases are filtered or relabeled.

rows.name: a manifest's delegate settings bring their builtin
a run waiting on a person exits 2 and resumes once answered
login saves a checked key readable only by its owner
run --stateless answers in one call and leaves no agent; runs get reads it back
the CLI deploys a manifest, runs its agent, and manages agents and definitions
the CLI reads the runtime's URL from CAMELAI_BASE_URL, as the SDKs do, or CAMELAI_URL
the MCP server deploys and runs agents for a coding agent
a tenant signs links to its agent's files with its own token, as for its volumes
fileArguments: other parties' servers are not offered or sent files unless a definition turns it on
files reach a tool as URLs bound to the call: a file at its version, a directory as a snapshot, small ones inline
a run's outcome lists the files it wrote and presented, and a presented file is an event with a download link
an upload streams to storage a chunk at a time: the source is never more than a few chunks ahead of storage
attachments over REST land in the workspace, the transcript keeps references, and the model sees them natively
the TypeScript SDK attaches bytes, Blobs, local paths and workspace files; a file deleted or replaced after attaching still reads as attached
the REST API stores the upload's type and serves downloads with safe headers
signed links: bound to tenant, volume, path, method, expiry, size and content type; tampering fails
MCP images, audio, blobs and long text are saved to the workspace, under sanitized names
MCP tools take files by {$file}: base64 or a call-bound URL, only from the agent's mounts
OpenAPI operations upload files (multipart, raw bytes, base64) and save binary responses
application-attached MCP files are saved to the workspace like a server's
web_fetch saves PDFs and images to the workspace and shows them to the model
POST /v1/images makes images on the platform's OpenAI key for a prepaid tenant, edits images given as base64, multipart or a URL, and is billed per token
POST /v1/images needs an OpenAI key, and a monthly cap refuses it
POST /v1/images with volumeId saves the images to the volume and answers their paths
the TypeScript SDK: images.generate and images.edit from bytes, a Blob or a URL, answered as base64 or saved to a volume
a thread with over 20 images, one of them 2,400 px, gets a request where every image is at most 1,568 px; the stored history is unchanged
an image whose scaling failed for now (its parse job crashed) is tried again on the next request, not held as omitted
an account's export holds its journey: what this runtime kept and what the store holds; an account journey never knew has none
an email sign-up is an account made when its mailed link is finished, in the browser that finishes it
a runtime with journey events off serves the console as ever: no tag, no cookie, no endpoint
with journey events on, an arrival is noted through the redirect, the browser gets its visitor id, and the console's pages reach the store
with journey events on, making an agent and running it tells the store of the agent, the day's activity and the account's first run
public accounts can email their verified address and cannot email strangers or suppressed recipients
a calendar wake-up tells the model its fixed local edition date
calendar schedules and owner-configured email round trip through the API without crossing accounts
web_fetch has Firecrawl render JavaScript shells, and only those, charging a platform render
a definition pins web_search's providers; a platform search is charged at the answering provider's price and counted in the hour's ledger entry
a search key the operator set for a tenant (its apiKeys) is used, and is not counted as the platform's
an operator's tenant without a key of its own searches on the platform's, recorded as platform usage and never charged; its own key wins; platformKeys: false keeps the refusal
codemode's searches on the platform's key stop once the tenant's credit is spent, without waiting for the next model request
web_search uses the tenant's own search key, else the platform's billed to credit, and pairs with web_fetch
X search works in agents and stateless runs, uses tenant keys first and bills only platform requests
a runtime bootstrapped from AGENT_TENANT and AGENT_OPERATOR_TOKEN serves that tenant
on a runtime configured by AGENT_TENANT, a run without a model key also names AGENT_TENANT_API_KEYS
a private runtime names no URL to browsers: AGENT_BROWSER_URL overrides the browser token's url, or empty leaves it out, and links carry their path on the runtime
a project is a keyed volume seeded once, mounted with the workspace beside it, and published as checked snapshots
a project is restored in place to a published version, and a check hands what it computed to store and the result
pinned versions outlast keep and the snapshot cap, carry labels, and a snapshot can be made from contents
publishTool finds the project from the call's identity, never its arguments, and tells the model what to fix
the REST API and SDK manage volumes within a tenant, and nothing crosses tenants
workspaces API validates ownership, inherits definitions, and accounts agent and stateless model calls
